Author: cchat
Name: cchat
Punchline: A compact messenger for FFXIV Tells.
Description: Open with /cchat. Tell history is saved unencrypted on this PC, separately for each character. cchat Presence shares your character name, home world, and live status with its server, not your Tell text. External image previews contact their hosts directly.
Changelog: Add locally cached recent 7TV emotes, preserve composer focus after sending, and improve outgoing Tell confirmation. Includes recent chats, message copying, and quoted replies.
